evidence_digest: The builder should canonicalize the source root before output creation and require each allowlisted entry to be a canonical regular file; source-root realpath equality also rejects linked ancestors. The package test should copy the neutral pnpm-json Tauri fixture, run the installed binary real init command, and verify 46 attributable provider entries, project-relative Cargo, staged dialog route, and request-dialog permission from the installed package. Release safety can provide static proof of canonical-source guards. The neutral fixture contains no provider source, so the tarball proof avoids repository vendor reliance.
risks: Windows realpath casing or path-format differences may require platform-safe canonical comparison.
Tarball installation depends on pnpm availability and local package-store behavior.
The init proof must avoid parsing incidental package-manager output as the CLI JSON result.
